name: Your agent programs in a computer
what: Any agent program runs in a computer unmodified, including one Silo does not offer to install. Silo works with a program only through its documented surfaces, and disguises nothing. The programs Silo offers, and what it knows of each (its name, where it keeps its sessions, how it takes a conversation up again), are data.

suggest.why: It is what lets you keep the agent programs you already use, and every other feature of agent programs stands on it.
